last_game_summary: Nebula Drift - top-down arena survival shooter with momentum thrust and dash, 4 enemy types incl. a Warden boss every 5th wave, energy-orb charged screen-clearing pulse, combo multiplier, power-up drops (repair/rapid/charge), particle VFX, screen shake, procedural animated sprites, and dependency-free synth audio

last_feedback.replayability: 7-8, yes - replayed to wave 21 before boredom set in
last_feedback.gripe: Only the fast small yellow enemies (Darters) and the boss were a real threat, and the boss could be trivially avoided by dashing. Dash should grant i-frames and should not collide with enemies you dash through/past. Some sounds felt off - boss hit sounds were too light. Biggest structural gripe: by wave 21 there was nothing new and no progression; difficulty needed to ramp faster and the game needed a roguelite-style upgrade system to stay enjoyable long term.
last_feedback.wish: Dash i-frames + phase-through, punchier/harder-hitting boss hit audio, faster difficulty ramp, roguelite progression/upgrades for long-term replay
